doc: Customer support operational hours: Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00. Saturdays from 10:00 to 14:00. Sundays and national holidays: Closed. The average response time during business hours is 2 hours.
Official contact channels: Email: support@fictionalstore.com. Phone: +1-800-FICT-SHOP. Physical Address: 123 Innovation Ave, Tech District. Social Media: @FictionalStore on Instagram and X.

Shipping policies: Standard Shipping: 3 to 5 business days. Express Shipping: 24 to 48 hours. Shipping Cost: Free on orders over $50 USD. For orders under $50 USD, a shipping fee of $5.99 USD applies. Coverage: National and international shipping available.

Returns and refunds policy: Return window: 30 calendar days from the date of order receipt. Conditions: The product must be unused, in its original packaging, and with tags attached. Process: Customers must initiate the request via email including the order number. Refunds are processed within 5 to 10 business days.

Accepted payment methods: Credit and Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express). Digital Wallets: PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay. Bank Transfers: Available for corporate purchases only. Cash and checks are not accepted.
